hypothesis: Phone wrong-word false warnings come from single channel-blurred consonants (ن/م, ف/ك, swallowed or truncated endings), and those blurs turn the written word into a non-word, whereas a planted swap is always a real attested word. Every try so far judged the heard span by a likelihood margin, where spikes and real swaps look equally marginal. Confirm a listener-evidenced wrong word only if its heard span spells a whole attested mushaf word other than the written word and its ±3 neighbours, using soft costs only. Predict 3 of 6 targets won with 1 loss: listener -3, overall -2.
